from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import json,hashlib,re
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
root=Path.cwd();d=root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1'
r=json.loads((d/'result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));freeze=json.loads((d/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sg=json.loads((d/'source_gate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));v=json.loads((d/'必要复核.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
p=pd.read_csv(d/'逐事件长端供给联合评分.csv');a=pd.read_parquet(d/'全部68事件及来源准入.parquet')
o=pd.read_csv(d/'全部固定高分机会.csv');orig=pd.read_parquet(root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/月度事件联合状态及标签.parquet')
primary=p[p.era.eq('2024—2025')];j=o[o.model.eq('joint')&o.era.eq('2024—2025')];c=o[o.model.eq('control')&o.era.eq('2024—2025')]
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
checks={}
checks['frozen_protocol_and_inputs']=sha(d/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256'] and all(sha(root/rel)==h for rel,h in freeze['input_hashes'].items())
checks['source_originals_and_state']=all(sha(d/rel)==h for rel,h in sg['source_hashes'].items()) and sha(d/'季度长端计划状态.parquet')==sg['quarter_field_hash']
checks['original_68_labels_preserved']=a.stat_month.tolist()==orig.sort_values('decision_at').stat_month.tolist() and np.allclose(a.actual_net5,orig.sort_values('decision_at').actual_net5,rtol=0,atol=0)
checks['event_and_fit_counts']=len(a)==68 and int(a.supply_eligible.sum())==40 and len(p)==28 and len(primary)==20 and r['total_new_fits']==84
assert set(a.loc[~a.supply_eligible,'supply_reason'])=={'当前日期之前无已登记季度来源'}
checks['saved_main_metrics']=abs(float(((primary.joint_prediction-primary.actual_net5)**2).mean())-r['primary_joint_mse'])<1e-14 and abs(float(((primary.control_prediction-primary.actual_net5)**2).mean())-r['primary_control_mse'])<1e-14
checks['all_five_high_windows_same']=j[['entry_date','exit_date']].to_numpy().tolist()==c[['entry_date','exit_date']].to_numpy().tolist() and np.allclose(j.prediction,c.prediction,atol=1e-12,rtol=0) and np.allclose(j.score,c.score,atol=1e-12,rtol=0) and not j.supply_on_actual_path.any()
checks['rejection_not_promoted']=not r['full_account_admission_passed'] and r['new_accounts']==0 and r['account_net_sharpe'] is None and r['goal_achieved'] is False
checks['existing_model_source_unchanged']=all(sha(root/rel)==h for rel,h in v['existing_model_source_hashes'].items())
protected={
 'config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json':['target_net_sharpe','target_net_cagr','target_max_drawdown','executable_assets','new_prospective_forecasts_enabled','orders_authorized','research_mode'],
 'config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json':['target_net_sharpe','target_net_cagr','target_max_drawdown','capital_cny','executable_assets','minimum_complete_cycles_each_full_calendar_year','account_tail_risk_contract','orders_authorized','permitted_price_observation_resolutions','minute_data_research_enabled']}
checks['targets_authority_and_risk_preserved']=True
for rel,keys in protected.items():
 current=json.loads((root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8'));old=freeze['authority_config_snapshots'][rel]
 checks['targets_authority_and_risk_preserved'] &= all(current.get(k)==old.get(k) for k in keys)
missing=[];e6links=0
for rel in ['docs/PROJECT_STATE.md','docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md']:
 text=(root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
  if '510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1' not in target:continue
  e6links+=1
  if not ((root/rel).parent/target).is_file():missing.append({'doc':rel,'target':target})
 checks['e6_links_present_'+Path(rel).stem]=not missing
assert all(checks.values()),checks
receipt={'checked_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'status':'PASS_SAVED_E6_OUTPUT_RECOMPUTATION_AND_SCOPE_CHECK','checks':checks,'e6_document_links_checked':e6links,
 'new_model_fits_in_this_check':0,'new_accounts_in_this_check':0,'new_repository_source_edits':0,
 'historical_first_vintage_verified':False,'independent_financial_validation':False,'goal_achieved':False,
 'source_objects':20,'quarter_roots':16,'scored_events':28,'total_single_run_fits':84,'final_status':r['status'],
 'result_sha256':sha(d/'result.json'),'report_sha256':sha(d/'季度长端供给增量_历史结论.md')}
(d/'保存输出与口径复核.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('长期文档定位：')
for rel in ['docs/PROJECT_STATE.md','docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md']:
 for i,line in enumerate((root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines(),1):
  if line.startswith('### 5.7') or line.startswith('### R64') or line.startswith('### E7'):print(rel,str(i),line)
